{{RV|type=command

|game1= tkoh
|version1= 1.01

|game2= arma3
|version2= 0.50

|gr1= Environment

|descr= Set ambient traffic speed in a rectangle (in kilometers per hour). {{Feature|arma3|This command does nothing in {{arma3}}.}}

|s1= [[setTrafficSpeed]] [speed, xMin, xMax, zMin, zMax]

|p1= speed: [[Number]] - traffic speed (in kilometers per hour)
|p2= xMin: [[Number]] - western border of the affected rectangle
|p3= xMax: [[Number]] - eastern border of the affected rectangle
|p4= zMin: [[Number]] - southern border of the affected rectangle
|p5= zMax: [[Number]] - northern border of the affected rectangle

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>setTrafficSpeed [50, _xMin, _xMax, _zMin, _zMax];</sqf>

|seealso= [[enableTraffic]] [[setTrafficDensity]] [[setTrafficDistance]] [[setTrafficGap]]
}}
